0.16.0.title: Folders only when you want them.
0.16.0.summary: Empty book folders are now opt-in, and a run of fixes stops ABM losing track of files after imports, upgrades and moves.
0.16.0.upgrade: If you ever saved Settings > Media Management, empty folders keep being created. Fresh installs start with it off.

0.15.5.title: Moving books actually moves them.
0.15.5.summary: Moving books between root folders said it worked while moving nothing. Now it moves them, and says how many moved and why any didn't.
0.15.5.upgrade: Adding a book now needs at least one root folder set up. ABM says so instead of adding a book with nowhere to go.
